ai_designer.brief: Oversee the arrangement’s progression ensuring the energy curve achieves the intended slow build and emotional impact.

presetor.brief: Assign and adjust presets emphasizing atmospheric sound design with granular and glitch-based effects.

songgps.brief: Manage the arrangement structure and section energy to align with the experimental trip hop style and slow build profile.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare tracks by balancing unprocessed channel audio to highlight sample chop techniques and maintain clarity in emotional delivery.
